job.title: QA and Release Manager
job.description:
The Company
  
I am recruiting on behalf of a long term client experiencing sustained growth and commercial success; they a multi-award winning trading and risk management software provider to the energy and commodities markets.
  
With offices in Australia, UK, USA and clients in over twenty countries, backed by a European energy exchange company, they are recognised as a global leader in energy and commodity pricing and analytics.
  
The Role
  
My client is looking to appoint an experienced QA & Release Manager to join their engineering team full-time in Sydney CBD, reporting to the Head of Engineering.

This hands-on senior role includes leading a small QA team, driving quality engineering best practice, owning release management, and software license administration.

The role is ideal for someone with a strong background in test automation, integration testing and quality engineering.The primary duties and responsibilities of this role include, but are not limited to:
  • Leading, mentoring and developing a small QA team, driving continuous improvement in QA processes and practices.
  • Owning and evolving automated testing capability (including an existing Python-based framework), with a focus on integration, regression and end-to-end testing.
  • Overseeing test planning, execution and quality reporting across multiple projects.
  • Owning and improving the release process, coordinating release readiness, regression testing and production verification across Development, QA and Customer Success.
  • Managing application licensing across the product suite, ensuring provisioning aligns with client contracts and coordinating renewals with compliance and account management.
Required Skills / Attributes

You'll bring 7+ years' experience in Software QA, including 2+ years leading a team, and a genuine passion for robust, well-tested software.

Self-motivated and comfortable working across diverse, international teams, you'll also have:
  • A quantitative degree (computer science, engineering or mathematics); ISTQB certification well regarded.
  • Strong experience with automated testing frameworks ideally improving existing suites, not just executing tests.
  • A solid understanding of integration, API and end-to-end testing, plus SQL Server experience.
  • Experience with source control, defect-tracking tools, and driving continuous improvement in a QA/engineering function, including quality metrics reporting.
  • Comfortable working across both Waterfall and Agile environments.
  • Exposure to quantitative methods/finance, and ideally Python or C#/.NET.
Is This You?
  
You must have unrestricted rights to work in Australia and be able to come to the Sydney CBD access with ease.
  
A test of your aptitude will be part of the selection process.
  
I am interviewing now so please apply online, email jorge@extendconsulting.com.au or contact Jorge Albinagorta on 61 (0) 439 781 736. I would love to share more with you if you are genuinely interested in the role and you meet the position criteria.
  
As an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, Extend and my client provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected characteristic.
  
Thank You!

job.title: Quantitative Support Analyst
job.description:
The Company

I am recruiting on behalf of a long term client who is experiencing sustained growth and success across the regions they operate in. They are a multi-award winning trading and risk management software provider to the energy and commodities markets.

With offices in Australia, UK and USA, they have a strong international client base with clients in over twenty countries. Backed by a European energy exchange company, this organisation has been recognised as a global software leader for energy and commodity pricing and analytics.

The Role 

With the ever increasing number of customers and existing team members executing their career progression plans, my client is continuing to invest in the team focused on providing excellent client experiences, post implementation.

To join this team, my client is looking to retain a driven Quantitative Support Analyst who will investigate, test and resolve product and service queries, offering information and education through in-depth knowledge of my client’s product / solutions.

This is a full-time, hybrid role based in London, UK.

The primary duties and responsibilities of this role include, but are not limited to, the following:
  • Manage the ticket queue system, providing remote support to our global customer base
  • Manage the resolution of customer product or service problems through troubleshooting technical issues, determining the root cause of the issue, managing the escalation if required and communicating the progress and solution to the client.
  • Applying your quantitative and mathematical knowledge to understand my client’s platform to investigate and resolve tickets
  • Demonstrate a solid commitment to customer service focusing on quality and timeliness of communication and feedback.
  • Contribute towards support and training documentation, both creation and maintenance.
  • Participate in client training.
Required Skills / Attributes

To be successful in this role you will likely have a quantitative analyst / actuarial background, as well as an understanding of university level mathematics and strong desire to apply your statistical, analytical, programming and finance knowledge.

Experience working in the energy and commodities markets and/or knowledge of trading, valuation and risk analytics would be a massive advantage, but not essential.

You will be self-motivated, be able to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges and situations.

Additionally, you will likely have and be able to demonstrate:
  • A client centered approach and excellent communication skills.
  • A bachelor’s degree, or higher, with a quantitative or finance emphasis.
  • Exposure to quantitative methods and/or finance.
  • Ability to self-organise, multi-task and deliver to deadlines.
  • Being a self-starter with the ability to work independently as well as part of an international, multi-location team.
  • Experience with Excel/VBA and SQL (Knowledge of C# would be an advantage)
Is This You?

You must have unrestricted rights to work in The UK.

A test of your technical skills will be part of the selection process.

I am interviewing now so please apply online, email jorge@extendconsulting.com.au or contact Jorge Albinagorta on 61 (0) 439 781 736 via WhatsApp. I would love to share more with you if you are genuinely interested in the role and you feel you meet the position criteria.

As an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, Extend and my client provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Thank You!
